IMPLEMENTED SCOPE
Native rounded nonmodal TopNotice uses UiPalette light/dark surfaces, one-line
title, two-line description and 44dp action/dismiss targets. Base timeouts are
4.5s normally and 8s for actions, respecting accessibility timeout settings.
Updates replace/deduplicate notices; navigation, pause and destroy clear them.
This includes page changes within Album. Action callbacks verify sourceRoute,
preventing an obsolete Connect action from recreating a live intent after leaving.
Root feedback shortens copy, exposes details where needed and deduplicates revisions.

start/success/failure, photo-index preparation and short save results use notices.
Actions offer connection, adding a preset, reading photos or viewing details.

slot confirmation. Photo Live connection intent is created only by clicking the
notice action; naming/confirmation still precedes reception. Long errors/failure

and project forms retain dialogs and existing confirmation protections.
